chunks: More than one of our companions reported that he said:
Do not speak regarding the Imam, for the Imam hears the speech while he is in the belly of his mother. Then when she gives birth to him, the angel writes between his eyes:
And the Word of your Lord has been completed in truth and justice; there is none to alter His Words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Then when he rises with the Command, a beacon is raised for him in every town, from which he looks upon the deeds of the servants.

key_terms.أَعْمَالِ الْعِبَادِ: The deeds of the servants, which the Imam beholds.
key_terms.السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ: The Hearing, the Knowing; divine attributes appearing in the Qur’anic quotation.
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: The Imam, the divinely appointed guide and authority being described in the narration.
key_terms.الْمَلَكُ: The angel who writes between the Imam's eyes at birth.
key_terms.بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ: The womb of his mother, indicating the Imam's state before birth.
key_terms.بِالْأَمْرِ: With the Command, referring to the Imam's rise in his divinely ordained function.
key_terms.كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ: The Word of your Lord, cited from the Qur’an to indicate divine truth and justice.
key_terms.مَنَارٌ: A beacon or marker raised for him in every town.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the Imam hearing speech before birth and seeing the deeds of people?
ai.summary: This hadith describes distinctive qualities of the Imam, including awareness before birth and a divinely marked status from the moment of birth. It also connects the Imam's station to a Qur’anic declaration of divine truth and justice, and portrays his oversight of the deeds of the servants when he stands with the Command.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said, 
‘More than one of our companions reported that he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘

Do not be speaking regarding the Imam<sup>asws</sup>, for the Imam<sup>asws</sup> hears the speech while he<sup>asws</sup> is in the belly of his<sup>asws</sup> mother. So when she places him<sup>asws</sup>, the Angel writes between his<sup>asws</sup> eyes:
[6:115] And the Word of your Lord has been accomplished truly and justly; there is none who can change His Words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
So when he<sup>asws</sup> does stand with the command, a beacon is raised for him<sup>asws</sup> in every city. He<sup>asws</sup> looks from it to the deeds of the servants’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following.

“Several persons of our people have narrated that The Imam (a.s.) has said, “Do not speak about the Imam. The Imam (a.s.) hears the words while he still is in the womb of his mother. When she would give birth the angel write between his eyes, “.
.in all truth and justice, your Lord’s Word has been completed. No one can change His Words. He is All-hearing and All-knowing.”.
[6:115] When takes charge of the matter (Leadership with Divine Authority) in every a light house will be established for him through which he would examine the deeds of the servants (of Allah).”
